title: OnePlus 6 and xDrip with MiaoMiao 2 - signal missed at night time
symptom: Throughout the day the MiaoMiao stays connected to xDrip, but a few hours into the night it stops receiving data, shows 'Signal Missed', and when trying to reconnect via BT scan it does not reconnect until the MiaoMiao is reset.
cause: OnePlus devices can turn off connectivity at night due to a setting called 'sleep standby optimization'.
fix: Turn off 'sleep standby optimization' in the battery optimization advanced settings.
evidence_quote: OP devices can turn off connectivity at night. I've just turned it off so tonight I'll see if it works. Try this: Settings: battery: battery optimization: three dots: advanced optimization: turn off sleep standby optimization.
